## Checklist

- [ ] I ran the verification covering my change (`pnpm --filter @torium-network/sdk verify`, `go test ./...` in `chain/app`, `make -C contracts check`, or the docs gates — whichever applies).

- [ ] User-facing changes are reflected in `apps/developer-docs` and, for the SDK, in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] No secrets, private keys, or key-shaped fixtures are included.
